svg.title: Saturation: the output is pinned at its limit
svg.desc: Animated graph of controller output in volts. When the setpoint jumps, the blue line for what P+D+FF asks for leaps far above the 12 V battery line, while the thick orange line for what the motor gave stays pinned flat at about 12 V; the red area between them fills in as it is drawn and is labeled flat out. A dashed line shows that asking with more kP only asks for more: the motor still gives the same 12 V, so the gains don't matter during that stretch. When the asked line drops under 12 V, the motor follows it again. To be faster there, change the hardware, such as gearing, current limit or a bigger motor, or ask for less.
svg.text: Saturation: the output is pinned at its limit
Asking for more than the motor can give. While flat out, the gains don't matter.
What the controller asked for, and what the motor got (volts)
The battery has about 12 V, and the current limit caps the current. When
P+D+FF asks for more, the motor gives all it can and no more: more kP
here changes nothing. To be faster, change the hardware or ask for less.
